subagents.initial_prompt:
Perform the Intake phase (`spec-intake`) for feature `p2-h-governance-ticketing-queues-and-actions` (Story `P2-H` in `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`).

Context & instructions:
1. Read `.agents/skills/spec-intake/SKILL.md`, `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`, `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/context-map.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/nfr-slo.md`, `openapi/api-v1.yaml` (around `/api/v1/tickets/**`), `app/backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V4__execution_and_governance_schema.sql`, and existing governance/execution/iam classes in `app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/governance/` and `app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/iam/`. Also read `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-f-execution-upload-and-run-lifecycle.md` and `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-g-execution-recipe-engine-and-artifacts.md` for consistent conventions.
2. Applicable cross-story lessons from `docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`:
   - `L-002`: Name PostgreSQL-backed integration tests `*Test.java` unless Maven Failsafe is explicitly wired in `pom.xml`.
   - `L-003`: Define dedicated port value types (`StoredObjectMetadata` in `com.example.app.execution.port`) on cross-context ports rather than returning internal domain entities.
   - `L-004`: Annotate refusal-auditing service methods with `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` and use 2-argument `Objects.requireNonNull(dep, "dep must not be null")` in constructors.
   - `L-005`: Annotate read/dry-run service methods that emit synchronous database audit rows via `AuditEventPort` with `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` instead of inheriting `@Transactional(readOnly = true)`.
   - `L-008`: Expose a package-private accessor method (`other.jdbcTemplate()`) on `@Repository` classes when copying `JdbcTemplate` references so the CGLIB proxy forwards the call to the target bean.
3. Produce `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-h-governance-ticketing-queues-and-actions.md` (overwrite the placeholder title file) following `spec-intake` and the exact conventions of `P2-F` / `P2-G`:
   - Header metadata:
     - `Milestone: P2 — MVP / Core Features`
     - `Milestone file: docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`
     - `Story: P2-H`
     - `Surfaces: backend`
     - `Material: no`
   - `## User story`: exact sentence from `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md` row `P2-H`:
     `As a finance approver, I want a unified governance ticketing engine across SAP_REPORT_POSTING, REPORT_DEFINITION_CREATE, REPORT_DEFINITION_CHANGE, RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH, REFERENCE_TABLE_CREATE, REFERENCE_TABLE_CHANGE, SCHEDULE_CHANGE, and IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION with To Do, My Requests, All, and Manage queue views and approve, reject, cancel, reassign, change owner, comment, attachment, and direct artifact download actions, so that all operational postings, configuration updates, and access requests follow maker-checker governance.`
   - `## Acceptance criteria`: `AC-1` through `AC-8` (match the milestone `Size: 8`), covering:
     - `AC-1` (`Kind: happy`): Create governance tickets (`POST /api/v1/tickets` with `Idempotency-Key`, supporting all 8 ticket types `SAP_REPORT_POSTING`, `REPORT_DEFINITION_CREATE`, `REPORT_DEFINITION_CHANGE`, `RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH`, `REFERENCE_TABLE_CREATE`, `REFERENCE_TABLE_CHANGE`, `SCHEDULE_CHANGE`, `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION`) and inspect ticket detail (`GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}` returning ticket metadata, comments, attachments, and `ETag`).
     - `AC-2` (`Kind: happy`): Query governance tickets across the four queue views (`GET /api/v1/tickets?queue=TODO|MY_REQUESTS|ALL|MANAGE`, plus optional `ticketType`, `status`, `search`, `page`, `limit` filters) with deterministic ordering and pagination metadata.
     - `AC-3` (`Kind: happy`): Approve (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve`) and reject (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/reject`) a `PENDING_APPROVAL` ticket with `If-Match` / `version` optimistic locking, maker-checker separation (`requester_user_id != decided_by_user_id`), system comment/audit logging, and terminal immutability.
     - `AC-4` (`Kind: happy`): Cancel (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/cancel`), reassign (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/reassign`), and change owner (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/owner`) on a `PENDING_APPROVAL` ticket with `If-Match` / `version` optimistic locking, recording system comments and audit events.
     - `AC-5` (`Kind: happy`): Add operator comments (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/comments`), upload file attachments (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/attachments` multipart upload stored in the S3 `tickets` bucket via `ObjectStoragePort` with SHA-256 checksum), and stream/download ticket attachments or linked report run artifacts directly from the ticket context (`GET /api/v1/tickets/{id}/attachments/{attachmentId}` and/or `GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/artifacts/{type}` linked from `targetRunId`). Check `openapi/api-v1.yaml` and `V4__execution_and_governance_schema.sql` for the exact routes and schema!
     - `AC-6` (`Kind: edge`): Idempotent ticket submission replay (24h window returning original `201 Created` / `200 OK` on matching payload), terminal ticket immutability (`APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `CANCELLED` guarded by `trg_governance_tickets_terminal_immutable`), and compensating S3 cleanup (`ObjectStoragePort.deleteObject`) if database persistence fails after uploading a ticket attachment.
     - `AC-7` (`Kind: negative`): Refuse unauthenticated callers (`401 AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED`), unauthorized callers (`403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN` with `AUTHZ_DENIED` audit log), BOLA/ownership violations on cancel or queue access, maker-checker self-approval (`requester_user_id == approver_user_id`, `403 SOD_MAKER_CHECKER_VIOLATION`), and mutating calls under an active `View-As` overlay (`403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN` with `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_BLOCKED` audit log).
     - `AC-8` (`Kind: negative`): Refuse unknown ticket/attachment IDs (`404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`), invalid ticket state transitions on already-terminal tickets (`409 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT` / `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`), stale `If-Match` / `version` values (`412 PRECONDITION_FAILED`), `Idempotency-Key` payload replay mismatches (`409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REPLAY_CONFLICT`), invalid attachment uploads (empty file, size limit exceeded, disallowed content type / magic bytes, path traversal filenames), and S3 storage failures (`502 ARTIFACT_STORAGE_ERROR`).
   - Include `## Preconditions`, `## Desk check`, `## Out of scope` (noting cross-context freeze/archive cutover `P2-K`, configuration cutover `P2-L`, IAM SoD/role grant `P2-M`, and React UI `P2-S`), `## NFRs`, `## Security-review triggers` (including `upload`, `RBAC`, `auth`, `any {id} path`, and sensitive actions), `## Regulations`, `## Open questions` (`none`), and an empty `## Delivery approvals` table (header + separator only, no approved row yet).
4. Do NOT write `p2-h-governance-ticketing-queues-and-actions.phase-result.md` and do NOT run `sync-feature-state.sh`. Do not run any shell commands unless strictly needed (prefer read/grep tools).

  - **AC-2 (`happy`)**: Query governance tickets across `TODO`, `MY_REQUESTS`, `ALL`, and `MANAGE` queue views (`GET /api/v1/tickets`) with status, `ticketType`, `search`, and offset pagination.
